settings.heading: our story
settings.text:
Togaether began with muhabbet, the Turkish art of warm, unhurried conversation. We wanted to bring that feeling to people who had never met, in cities where it is easy to feel alone in a crowd.

Since then, thousands of strangers have sat down together in living rooms, gardens and studios across Türkiye and Spain. Some came back as friends. Some came back as hosts.

settings.heading: our approach and experience
settings.intro: Every circle follows the same gentle rhythm, so strangers can settle in and meet each other for real.

settings.heading: what we have gathered so far.

settings.question: will i be seated with strangers?
settings.answer: Yes, and that's the point. Most people come on their own. Your host welcomes everyone and guides the first moments, so nobody is left on the sidelines.

settings.question: do i have to speak?
settings.answer: Only as much as you'd like. Listening is a full part of the circle, and you can always pass.

settings.question: what language is the event in?
settings.answer: Each experience lists its language in the calendar, usually English, Turkish or Spanish, and sometimes a mix.

settings.question: how long does it last?
settings.answer: Most circles last two to three hours. The exact duration is shown on each experience.

settings.question: what does it cost?
settings.answer: The price is listed on each experience and usually covers the venue, materials and something to eat or drink.

settings.question: why do i need to apply?
settings.answer: Circles are small, so a short application helps us bring together a group that will feel good together. We reply to everyone.

settings.heading: what to expect at your first circle.
settings.box_title: why we ask you to apply
settings.box_text: Each circle is small and carefully balanced. A short application helps us bring together people who will feel at home with each other.

settings.heading: facilitating connection.
settings.quote: I hold the space so everyone else can simply arrive. The rest happens between the people in the room.
